patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution product and lifestyle photography dominates hero and key section introductions, often with text overlaid on a dark, muted portion of the image.

A sophisticated dark theme uses deep charcoal (#171717) as the primary background, contrasted with crisp white text and vibrant, multi-colored accents derived directly from the featured watch designs.
Headings are set in a large, bold, sans-serif typeface, often in all caps, creating a strong, authoritative presence, while body text is smaller and highly legible.

The header bar transforms from a transparent, slightly taller state to an opaque, smaller bar with a solid background and subtle shadow upon scrolling down. The hero image exhibits a subtle parallax effect where the foreground watch element moves at a slightly different speed than its background.
Content sections alternate between full-width imagery and structured grids for product showcases and news articles, maintaining a consistent dark background for most textual content blocks.

technique_notes: To rebuild the hero, use a large, high-quality image with a dark overlay or a dark area for text placement. Implement a subtle parallax effect where the main product (watch) moves slightly faster or scales independently of its background as the user scrolls.
The sticky header should transition its height, background color, and potentially add a shadow class when the scroll position moves past the initial hero section.
Content sections below the hero appear to reveal themselves, likely with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation, as they enter the viewport during scrolling.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual anchors, complemented by smaller, highly legible body and label text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for most structural elements and images, with subtle rounding on buttons and product cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and between major sections, creating a sense of luxury and focus, transitioning to a balanced density within product grids and news layouts.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dramatic, full-bleed product photography, often featuring watches in vibrant, multi-colored ceramics, against a sophisticated dark background, creates an immersive and luxurious brand experience that feels more like an editorial spread than a typical e-commerce site. The subtle motion and elegant typography reinforce this premium feel.
